tests.name: app-bruteforce-attack
tests.description: 5 failed logins from one IP within 2 minutes must trigger the brute-force correlation rule.

tests.name: app-bruteforce-benign-service-account
tests.description: Failed logins from an allow-listed automation account must be suppressed, not correlated as brute force.

tests.name: lsass-mimikatz-attack
tests.description: Non-allow-listed process reading LSASS with a Mimikatz-consistent access mask must hit the high-confidence rule.

tests.name: lsass-defender-benign
tests.description: Windows Defender's legitimate LSASS access must be suppressed via the allow-list, not alert.

tests.name: process-injection-shellcode
tests.description: CreateRemoteThread with no backing module must trigger the shellcode-injection rule.

tests.name: powershell-encoded-attack
tests.description: PowerShell ScriptBlock with -enc/-nop/-w hidden/download-cradle indicators must be flagged suspicious.

tests.name: powershell-benign-admin-script
tests.description: Ordinary signed admin scriptblock logging must not trip the suspicious-content rule.

tests.name: credential-access-full-chain
tests.description: injection -> LSASS dump -> suspicious PowerShell within 5-minute windows must escalate all the way to the level-15 incident rule.
